{"bytes":315003,"code":200,"codeText":"OK","durationMs":5579,"result":"# text-wrap: balance Status and Details\n\n## Baseline Status\n**Newly available** - Since **March 2024**, this feature works across the latest devices and browser versions.\n\n## Line-Count Limits\n\nThe `balance` value has computational limits:\n\n- **Chromium**: 6 lines or less\n- **Firefox**: 10 lines or less\n\nAs stated in the documentation:\n> Because counting characters and balancing them across multiple lines is computationally expensive, this value is only supported for blocks of text spanning a limited number of lines (six or less for Chromium and ten or less for Firefox).\n\n## Fallback Behavior\n\nWhen `text-wrap: balance` is unsupported or exceeds line limits, the text wraps using the default `wrap` behavior:\n\n```css\ntext-wrap: balance;  /* Falls back to normal wrapping if unsupported or over line limit */\n```\n\nThe fallback is the standard text wrapping behavior (breaking at appropriate characters like spaces), which is the default behavior and ensures content remains readable in older browsers.\n\n## Use Case\n`balance` is specifically recommended for **short text blocks** like:\n- Headings\n- Captions\n- Blockquotes\n\nIt enhances layout quality and legibility by distributing characters evenly across lines, rather than having an unbalanced final line.","url":"https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/text-wrap"}
